Morbi runs one of the world's largest ceramic tile clusters, along with sanitaryware, wall clocks and plastics. Thousands of units across Morbi GIDC, Ghuntu, Lakhdhirpur and the Rafaleshwar / 8-A highway belt push huge production and dispatch volumes every day. Yards like these â€” dusty, hot and dispatch-heavy â€” need supervisor, QC and dispatch cabins built to take it. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller. As a Container Office Manufacturer for Morbi Ceramic Units, we build steel units and dispatch them from our Greater Noida factory. This page covers what Morbi buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Morbi

Ceramic tile and sanitaryware factories use them as supervisor, QC/lab and admin cabins on the production floor. Dispatch and packing yards use them as dispatch, documentation and gate cabins for the heavy outbound movement. Sample and display teams use them as compact buyer-meeting cabins. Clock, plastics and MSME units use them as small supervisor posts. Expansion contractors on new kilns and sheds use them as site offices. The common need is a rugged cabin that arrives finished and holds up in a dusty, hot yard.

Morbi industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the ceramic belt:

  • Morbi GIDC / Morbi ceramic zone (363641) â€” the core ceramic and sanitaryware estate; supervisor, QC and admin cabins.
  • Ghuntu ceramic belt (363641) â€” tile and sanitaryware units on the Ghuntu side; site and dispatch cabins.
  • Lakhdhirpur ceramic belt (363642) â€” the dense Lakhdhirpur tile cluster; admin and documentation cabins.
  • Rafaleshwar GIDC / 8-A National Highway belt (363642) â€” units and dispatch yards along the highway; gate and dispatch cabins.

Sites outside these pockets â€” the Morbiâ€“Wankaner road or the Morbi-2 area â€” are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Morbi
10 ft10 Ã— 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 Ã— 8 ftProduction-floor supervisor, QC or dispatch cabin
40 ft40 Ã— 8 ftMulti-desk admin office, office + sample display combined

For a dispatch-heavy ceramic yard we can supply a combined storage and office container for dispatch yards. Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated for heat
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision
  • Optional AC and added insulation for hot yard conditions

Customisation options

Most Morbi orders are customised to the yard. We can add: added insulation and AC provision for hot, dusty conditions; partition walls for separate cabins; a dispatch-window or documentation-counter layout for packing yards; a cleaner finish for sample and buyer-meeting cabins; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; and ramps or external steps. Compact 10 ft and 20 ft units suit busy ceramic plots. Tell us the team size, the yard conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Morbi

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Morbi by road, roughly 1,190â€“1,280 km via the NH48 corridor to Ahmedabad and onward via Rajkot to the Morbi ceramic belt. It is a long but well-established route; we confirm the exact transit window at quotation. A default delivery charge of â‚¹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport set by distance and yard offloading access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We serve container offices for Ahmedabad projects on the same route, so the line into Saurashtra is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1â€“2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20â€“25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price, documentation and after-sales â€” useful for the fast-moving ceramic supply chain. We supply across Gujarat, including container offices supplied around Surat and container office builds for Vadodara sites.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Morbi depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), insulation and AC for hot yards, partitioning, dispatch-window layout, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and the long-haul transport from our factory. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Morbi?

Price depends on size, insulation/AC for hot yards, partitions, dispatch-window layout, electricals and fit-out, plus long-haul transport from our Greater Noida factory. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft admin office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification â€” share your requirement for an itemised price.

Can the cabin handle a hot, dusty ceramic yard?

Yes â€” we insulate for heat and can add AC provision, plus sealed windows and a durable finish suited to a dusty yard. Tell us the yard conditions and we advise on the right build.

How long does delivery take to Morbi?

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, roughly 1,190â€“1,280 km away via the NH48 corridor through Ahmedabad and Rajkot. It is a long-haul route, so we confirm the exact transit window at order stage based on your yard and offloading access.

Can you supply a dispatch cabin with a storage section?

Yes. Alongside plain office cabins we can supply a combined storage-and-office unit suited to a packing and dispatch yard. Tell us the split you need and we configure the layout.
